stage: focused caller correctness and assembly only; no formal speed comparison

build.cpp: Clang Release -O3 -march=native -fno-strict-aliasing; ASan+UBSan in ASan profile
build.rust: stable normal/nightly ASan release, target-cpu=native, v0 symbol mangling, ThinLTO, one codegen unit
build.native_tests: Reuse unchanged full native before/after source proofs; no repeat full backend matrix
build.dependency_collection: Every actual .o.d/*.d, exact structured Cargo package/target/manifest mapping, dep LHS and actual/final executable identity for nightly output layout

placement.caller_affinity: first4 CPP or first8 Rust physical cores of leased socket, widened before numactl, requested T unchanged
placement.memory: explicit membind to leased NUMA node; constructor first-touch semantics retained
placement.lease: exclusive inherited WRITE flock for complete preflight, env and topology validated

correctness: Every streamed old and new key present
All four arms full guarded mixed serial and parallel output equal untimed serial oracle
Same seen-seed semantic fields equal exact committed native96 records; no old timing reuse
Exact full chronological Williams and contract order
Per-arm effective workers/scratch/spawn, populated allocation unavailable
Both fresh seeds rejected by check; old seed rejected by measure before workload construction

checks: A0 and A1 converge to same typed noinline Trial entry and actual address for each family
All3 native types have symmetric noinline Trial boundary outside internal clocks
Original requested T passed to actual public native entry inside insert and allocate+insert intervals
Policy current n/bytes inclusive gate executes between clocks (possibly in native callee)
Constructors allocation/zeroing inside allocation interval; prefill outside insert interval
Record exact before/clone package or namespace identities and raw symbols; report folded/shared or distinct addresses and instruction equivalence without assuming layout independence
No performance data or new compiler tuning used to adjust caller

failure_policy: Preserve every attempt/source/log; versioned repair only; no automatic rebuild of successful outputs
timing_interpretation: Four-trial validation durations are incidental correctness evidence, not training data, rankings or claims; formal fresh seeds remain unused.
